q.canon: Can the bearer shoot or defend against a stealthed enemy?

a.canon: Yes. The bearer can target stealthed minions with spells, shoot them with projectiles, attack or intercept them and even defend against their attacks.

q.canon: My Tufted Turtles attack (having taken no damage so far this turn), and then 3 Foot Soldiers defend. How much damage do my Tufted Turtles take?

a.canon: 0, because all three Foot Soldiers did damage at the same time, tied for first, and thus all are prevented!

q.canon: Does this count as healing?

a.canon: No, this is setting life.

q.canon: What happens if I cast this when I'm at death's door?

a.canon: You can cast it, and your opponent will go to 0 life, being put at Death's Door and becoming immune to damage for the rest of the turn. You will still remain at 0 life since you can't gain life once you're at death's door.

q.canon: For purposes of cards that care about the mana cost of spells, what is the mana cost of a spell with X?

a.canon: If you cast the spell, the mana cost is X. For example, if you cast it for 2 mana, then Immortal Throne would see it as a 2 cost spell. But, if you aren't casting the spell and it's simply in your hand, spellbook, etc., then X is 0 until you actually cast it.

q.canon: The alpha foil version has 3 air threshold and the normal version has 2 air threshold. Which is correct?

a.canon: The normal version is correct. You only need 2 air affinity to cast this minion.

q.canon: When Ultimate Horror summons dead voidwalk minions, can they go to different nearby sites and voids?

a.canon: Yes!

q.canon: Can it burrow and unburrow different things the same turn?

a.canon: Yes.

q.canon: Does Undertow let you pull a unit underwater if they have submerge?

a.canon: No, because it's a 'normal step,' which doesn't allow changing regions.

q.canon: What are the details of pulling an oversized minion that occupies the water site and other locations?

a.canon: When pulling or pushing a oversized unit, choose a single location the oversized unit occupies (and meets the requirement of the effect - e.g. adjacent), and push/pull from there.

q.canon: When it submerges, can it pull down a minion anywhere in the realm, or only from its location?

a.canon: No. Unland Eel can only drag a minion that shares its location.

q.canon: If I have two Vanguard Knights equally forward, do they cancel each other out?

a.canon: Yes. They only get the benefit if they are the true vanguard, with a single minion being the farthest forward.

q.canon: How do I know if they're the 'farthest forward?'

a.canon: The row of squares closest to you is 1, then the next row is 2, then 3, then 4. The higher the number, the farther forward it is.

q.canon: Does this prevent enemy magic from harming my beasts?

a.canon: Yes, as long as the effect says 'target'. You'll need to bring in a specialized exterminator to flush out these hidey-holes.

q.canon: What counts as an 'enemy' for this effect? Is it enemies of the beast, or enemies of the site?

a.canon: Beasts at Varmint Warrens cannot be targeted by spells or abilities used by the enemies of the beast. All kinds of critters can hide in the warrens!

q.canon: If I choose to submerge minions and artifacts here, do I submerge Vatn Draconis too?

a.canon: Yes, it will submerge itself. You cannot choose to submerge only some of the minions and artifacts.

q.canon: If I play this under my avatar, have I stopped there?

a.canon: No, because a unit doesn't enter the site if the unit was already present in the square when the site was played.

q.canon: What does 'stops here' mean?

a.canon: An avatar stops when there is no additional movement for that unit on the Storyline. A unit must first move to then stop.

q.canon: Does Vaults of Zul trigger once per game, or once per game per avatar?

a.canon: Once per game total. They took time to loot the vaults! (If two avatars somehow stop on the vaults simultaneously, they will both be tied for first, and will both loot the vaults.)

q.canon: What happens if my turn is skipped via Vaults of Zul and Courtesan Thaïs is affecting me?

a.canon: If a turn is skipped then there's no actual turn, which means that part of Courtesan Thaïs's effect would wait for that player's next actual turn.

q.canon: What does it mean to 'fly to' something? Does it have to be the shortest possible path or any valid path?

a.canon: Refer to the article on Moving to a Specific Location Via a Special Ability or Magic to see how an ability like this works.

links.name: Moving to a Specific Location Via a Special Ability or Magic

q.canon: When moving sites around, does Vindictive Nation protect the nearby sites before or after the move?

a.canon: Vindictive Nation protects the sites it was nearby before the move. For example: I = Vindictive Nation R = Rubble A = Allied Site My opponent casts Earthquake and rearranges the two rightmost sites: Even though site A moved and is now nearby Vindictive Nation, my opponent doesn't lose any life because A wasn't nearby Vindictive Nation before the move. Alternately, if we started from the second situation and Earthquake moved sites into the first situation, my opponent would lose 3 life because they moved a site that was nearby Vindictive Nation (even though the site ended up no longer nearby).

q.canon: If my Vindictive Nation is silenced by my opponent, e.g. Smokestacks of Gnaak, will my opponent lose life?

a.canon: Yes! Silence from Smokestacks is applied as a passive ability, but the act of silencing literally triggers Vindictive Nation's ability. So as Vindictive Nation becomes silenced, its ability triggers. See the Triggered Ability codex entry for details.

q.canon: Does this effect have time to resolve if the site itself is getting destroyed?

a.canon: Yes! They are very vindictive.

q.canon: Does 'modifying' a site include Flooding it?

a.canon: Yes, since Flooded is an ability that gets added to the site.

q.canon: If my Vindictive Nation is affected by my opponent's Atlantean Fate, do they lose 1 or 2 life?

a.canon: Two life. Vindictive Nation is flooded (which counts as modifying it) and then silenced (which also counts as modifying it).

q.canon: What does 'wherever she is' mean?

a.canon: Anywhere! The realm, your hand, and cemetery, and even while in the middle of your spellbook.

q.canon: Since Avatars are Spellcasters, is Vivien a Spellcaster?

a.canon: Not by default. Avatars don't have the printed ability 'Spellcaster,' so Vivien must gain the Spellcaster ability another way, e.g. a minion with the printed Spellcaster ability.

q.canon: Can Vivien the Enchantress copy the abilities of another Vivien the Enchantress?

a.canon: No.

q.canon: What happens if Vivien uses the Druid's ability to summon Bruin and flip?

a.canon: She summons Bruin and then flips. As a flipped card with nothing on the back, she has no game text and will effectively do nothing for the rest of the game. She is no longer a minion, has no card type or abilities, etc. The flipped card can exist in the void, and technically she could turn off Pristine Paradise, and would be destroyed by Roots of Yggdrasil.

q.canon: Does this affect subsurface units?

a.canon: No. (They are not atop the site.)

q.canon: What if this is animated by an Enchantress?

a.canon: An animated Wall of Air can't move (unless it gains power), since it has a Wall of Air in its middle! If it gains power (or teleports) and manages to move, the Wall of Air applies between the two squares it occupies.

q.canon: Does this affect the corners of the border? (e.g. Airborne units moving diagonally)

a.canon: No. 'Border' means adjacent squares, not including diagonals.

q.canon: How many squares does this aura occupy?
How many squares does this aura occupy?
What does 'passes through' mean?

a.canon: Moving through in any way, whether willingly or by force. For example, a unit moved by Grapple Shot or Pudge Butcher would take damage from the Wall of Fire. Note that a teleported unit doesn't pass through borders, and thus wouldn't be affected.

q.canon: Does this affect Airborne units?

a.canon: Yes. (They are atop the site.)

q.canon: Does this affect the corners of the border? (e.g. Airborne units moving diagonally)

a.canon: No. 'Border' means adjacent squares, not including diagonals.

q.canon: What if this is animated by an Enchantress?

a.canon: It can move, but units are not passing through the Wall of Fire due to its own movement. After moving, its effect will apply between the two squares it occupies.

q.canon: Does this affect subsurface units?

a.canon: No. (They are not atop the site.)

q.canon: How many squares does this aura occupy?
What if this is animated by an Enchantress?

a.canon: An animated Wall of Ice can't move normally, since it has a Wall of Ice in its middle! If it gains Airborne (or teleports, etc.) and manages to move, the Wall of Ice applies between the two squares it occupies.

q.canon: When is the power doubled?

a.canon: This effect applies a doubling throughout the turn. If the unit gains or loses power, apply any additions or subtractions first, then double.

q.canon: What does it mean to 'permanently lose stealth'?

a.canon: Simply remove the stealth token. It does not prevent the minion from gaining stealth later.

q.canon: What does 'drowns' mean?

a.canon: A minion 'drowns' if it dies due to being underwater without also having the submerge ability. You control the resulting Skeleton.

q.canon: How do I properly resolve this effect?

a.canon: Choose a cardinal direction from your water site. Forcefully move all enemies from your water site one step in the chosen direction and flood that site. Trigger and resolve any effects related to minions entering or the site being flooded. Then repeat the process until you reach the edge of the realm. The flood and push effect will continue even across a void, but minions cannot be forcefully moved across regions. Each site will be flooded at the same moment as the minions arrive, so a submerged minion being evicted will also be submerged on the new site (and there will never be a moment where it's pushed onto the new site without the new site also being flooded).

q.canon: When exactly does the previous site stop being flooded when I use this ability for the second time?

a.canon: The newly flooded site becomes flooded at the same moment the previously flooded site stops being flooded. If you choose the same site, there is no moment when the site isn't flood.

q.canon: If the site doesn't get flooded (e.g. Bedrock), do the minions without submerge still tap?

a.canon: Yes! Imagine a big wave washing over the Bedrock, knocking everyone over, and then the water dissipates due to Bedrock.

q.canon: What does 'your body of water' mean?

a.canon: The body of water (if any) that your Avatar currently occupies. If the Avatar isn't in any body of water, the ability won't function. (They're a fish out of water!)

q.canon: Can I choose the same site over and over?

a.canon: Yes, as long as it's nearby your body of water.

q.canon: Does the path include the starting and ending locations?

a.canon: Yes.

q.canon: Can a unit with move-related abilities (e.g. Airborne) 'take steps' using its ability?

a.canon: Yes.

q.canon: Do I fully resolve my movement first, then strike each enemy simultaneously?

a.canon: Yes.

q.canon: If I choose to move 0 steps (perhaps because my unit is Immobile), do I strike anything?

a.canon: No, because you don't have any path if you don't move. A path involves 1 or more steps, and each step has a starting and ending location that's different (if your step is from a location to the same location, you didn't actually move anywhere.)

q.canon: Can I choose to move a step forward and then back to strike an enemy twice with this?

a.canon: No. You can choose to step forward and back, but an enemy is either along your path or not. They will not be struck more than once.

q.canon: Can the White Hart's location be attacked?

a.canon: No, the White Hart's ability means that minions and locations which are nearby to the Hart, but are not the Hart, cannot be attacked. Everyone must focus on taking down the White Hart!

q.canon: Does 'visited before' apply to other Wildfires I cast in the same game?

a.canon: Once it leaves play, a Wildfire forgets all the places it visited. If you have multiple Wildfires in play, track them each separately.

q.canon: If Wills-o'-the-Wisps are attacked and then use their ability to evade the attack, what happens?

a.canon: Attack triggers are still satisfied (e.g. Captain Baldassare), but the attack otherwise ends (assuming there aren't any units left to fight). The attacker will not strike, and the target of the attack will not revert to the original target (if any).

q.canon: If Wills-o'-the-Wisps are attacked by a oversized minion, and then Wills-o'-the-Wisps teleport to a nearby location that the oversized minion still occupies, does the attack continue?

a.canon: Yes. To actually evade the attack, they must teleport to a location that the attacker doesn't occupy.

q.canon: Does the movement get resolved simultaneously?

a.canon: Yes, all the steps are simultaneously resolved (which might then provoke a variety of triggers).

q.canon: Can I push something into the void?

a.canon: No. Since this is forced movement (and not normal unit movement), 'one step' means a single adjacent location. (And 'adjacent location' means an adjacent square in the same region.)

q.canon: Per card text, artifacts that are carried get pushed as well. So, do held artifacts get blown away from the units carrying them?

a.canon: Since all of the movement is simultaneous the artifact always shares a location with the unit, so it was never dropped and continues to be carried.

q.canon: If a weaker ally is attacked and you return them to your hand via this ability, what happens?

a.canon: Attack triggers are still satisfied (e.g. Captain Baldassare), but the attack otherwise ends, assuming there aren't any units left to fight. The attacker will not strike.

q.canon: What does 'Occupies all locations safely' mean?

a.canon: Yog Sothoth occupies all locations simultaneously, in all regions. That includes all surface locations, subsurface locations and voids. Yog Sothoth does not die due to being burrowed or submerged and is not banished due to being in the void.

q.canon: What happens if there's a silence or disable effect somewhere in the realm that affects minions (e.g. Root Spider, Silence aura)?

a.canon: Yog-Sothoth will be disabled or silenced by the effect, but will continue to occupy all locations since its size is a characteristic. This usually means Yog-Sothoth will be banished, since it can no longer safely occupy void locations!

q.canon: What happens if Damion and his Ghouls are all damaged simultaneously by a Poison Nova?

a.canon: Damion dies from the Lethal damage but is still in the realm at the time his Ghouls would be marked for death, so his ability protects them. Each Ghoul will have one damage for the rest of the turn. (Lethal is relevant only while the damage is applied, and is not an ongoing quality of the damage after it is applied.)

q.canon: What happens when a minion carries another minion that's carrying a minion?

a.canon: Only the minions you're directly carrying count against your limit. Have fun at the carnival!
